audit.whatIsWrong: Two serious errors. (1) The entry calls Volibear's E 'Hand of the God' — that is not an ability in his kit at all; his E is Sky Splitter. (2) It attributes the stun to E in five separate strings ('E to stun you out of Heroic Swing', 'his E-stun'). Sky Splitter deals damage, SLOWS, and shields Volibear if he stands in the blast. The stun belongs to Thundering Smash (Q). Sky Splitter is also 1200 range, so the repeated claim that Akshan out-ranges 'his whole melee kit' is wrong too — he has a long-range poke.
audit.why: Riot's text for Sky Splitter: 'summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius', range 1200, 16s. Riot's text for Thundering Smash: 'Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks', range 300, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s. An Akshan player told to fear a 1200-range stun will never swing at all; told the truth — the stun is a 300-range charge that opens with an auto-attack reset — he knows the charge itself is the cue to leave.
audit.corrected: The stun is Thundering Smash (Q), 300 range, 12s, opening with an auto-attack reset. Sky Splitter (E) is a 1200-range, 16s slow that shields him if he stands in it. 'Hand of the God' does not exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry repeatedly says to poke 'whenever his W is on cooldown'. Frenzied Maul is 5 seconds — it is essentially never on cooldown, so that instruction never fires.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them. Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.' The heal requires a SECOND cast on the same mark, so the actionable rule is to break contact after the first bite, not to wait out a 5s cooldown. That also explains why anti-heal matters on the second maul specifically.
audit.corrected: Frenzied Maul is 5s; the heal only comes off the second cast on the same mark. Break contact after the first bite.

edits.before: Volibear is a real Level 1 body — his W-bite heals back any auto-trade you start, so even with your passive double-shot online you lose the melee brawl. Don't fight; last-hit at max Q range. By 2-3 you have Q plus a point in E and you finally out-range his bite: throw Avengerang on cooldown and weave your double-shot passive, but only when his W is down. The instant his E (Hand of the God) is up, respect it — getting stunned means his bite and Q-dash close the gap and you die in melee. Poke when the bite's on cooldown, never when it's up.
edits.after: Volibear is a real Level 1 body — Frenzied Maul (W) is a 5s bite whose SECOND cast on the same mark heals him, so deny the follow-up and the trade evens out. Don't brawl anyway; last-hit at max Q range. By 2-3 you out-range the bite, but not Sky Splitter (E): 1200 range on 16s, slowing you and shielding him if he stands in it. The stun is Thundering Smash (Q) — 300 range, 12s, opening with an auto-attack reset, so the moment he starts charging is your cue to leave, not the bite that follows it.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are your laning peak. Your E swing-poke and Q out-range everything he has in melee, so kite along the wave and force him to eat boomerangs while his W heal is on cooldown. At 6, Comeuppance is a genuine answer to his dive — if he Q-dashes in and bites, swing out on E and lock R onto him; because the damage scales with his missing health, a Voli who over-committed gets executed from range, and the takedown drops your E to a 0.5s cooldown for a free reset. Just never sit still long enough for his E-stun to catch you mid-swing.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are your laning peak. Your swing-poke and Q beat everything he has in melee — but Sky Splitter reaches 1200, so he still slows you from outside it and shields himself doing it. Kite along the wave and force him to eat boomerangs while his Frenzied Maul mark goes unspent. At 6, Comeuppance answers his dive — if he charges in and bites, swing out on E and lock R on; the missing-health scaling executes a Voli who over-committed, and the takedown drops your E to 0.5s. Never stand still long enough for a Thundering Smash charge to land.

edits.before: This is where the lane slips, which is why it stays Voli-favoured overall. Once he hits two items he's a tank with a built-in self-heal, and your lethality bounces off — Q and the double-shot chip for nothing while his E-stun plus R disabling your turret let him dive you for free. You have to cash the early-to-mid window: snowball off the Youmuu's spike, take plates, and roam with W camo near terrain before ~20 minutes. Critically, your burst alone won't close him out — pair lethality with grievous wounds (Executioner's / Mortal Reminder) so his W can't heal through it. If it goes long, you only poke and play for picks with R; you will not win the scaled 1v1.

notes: 'Hand of the God' is not a Volibear ability — it is not a near-miss spelling, it is a name from a different champion entirely, and it sat in both early and wants.foe[0]. This is the same class of error the tahmkench mirror found ('Piercing Arrow' attributed to Akshan), so it is worth a sweep across the Akshan file for other wrong-champion substitutions. The bigger mechanical fix: the stun is Thundering Smash (Q, 300 range), not the E — the page put it on E five times, and Sky Splitter is actually a 1200-range slow that shields him. That also kills the repeated claim that Akshan out-ranges his entire kit. Finally, 'poke when his W is on cooldown' was unusable advice against a 5s ability; the real rule is that the heal only lands on the second maul against the same mark.
